name: Shiza
overview: Shiza was a male member of the tribe of Reuben, identified specifically as 'the Reubenite.' His mention in Scripture is concise, highlighting his tribal affiliation without additional narrative details.
namesAndTitles: The name 'Shiza' appears once in Scripture without an explicit meaning or divine origin noted. It is presented simply as a proper name in 1 Chronicles 11:42.
familyAndRelationships: Shiza is identified as the father of Adina and a descendant of Reuben, indicating his place within the Reubenite lineage. Beyond these relationships, Scripture does not provide further family details.
scriptureSignificance: Shiza's significance lies in his identification as a warrior from the tribe of Reuben, as indicated by his title 'the Reubenite.' His mention in the genealogical and military listings of 1 Chronicles situates him among those who contributed to Israel's tribal and military history, reflecting the ongoing faithfulness of God's people through their tribal heritage.
